initScript: window.rSelectedChip = 10; window.rBets = {}; window.rSpinning = false; const numbersOrder = [0, 32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8, 23, 10, 5, 24, 16, 33, 1, 20, 14, 31, 9, 22, 18, 29, 7, 28, 12, 35, 3, 26]; const redNumbers = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36]; window.rAngle = 0; function drawWheel() { const canvas = document.getElementById('roulette-canvas'); if (!canvas) return; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const cx = canvas.width / 2; const cy = canvas.height / 2; const radius = cx - 10; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); const sliceAngle = (Math.PI * 2) / numbersOrder.length; numbersOrder.forEach((num, idx) => { const start = window.rAngle + idx * sliceAngle; const end = start + sliceAngle; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, start, end); ctx.fillStyle = num === 0 ? 'bg-red-700 hover:bg-red-600' : 'bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800'; gridEl.innerHTML += '<div onclick=

>'; } } window.setChip = function(val) { window.rSelectedChip = val; document.querySelectorAll('.chip-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.classList.remove('scale-110', 'ring-2', 'ring-amber-300', 'opacity-100'); btn.classList.add('opacity-70'); }); const activeBtn = document.getElementById('chip-' + val); if (activeBtn) { activeBtn.classList.add('scale-110', 'ring-2', 'ring-amber-300', 'opacity-100'); activeBtn.classList.remove('opacity-70'); } }; window.placeBet = function(type, key) { if (window.rSpinning) return; const betKey = type + '' + key; if (state.points < window.rSelectedChip) { document.getElementById('roulette-status').innerText = 'Insufficient bankroll points!'; return; } state.points -= window.rSelectedChip; window.rBets[betKey] = (window.rBets[betKey] || 0) + window.rSelectedChip; updatePointsDisplay(); const badge = document.getElementById('chip-count-' + key); if (badge) { badge.classList.remove('hidden'); badge.innerText = window.rBets[betKey]; } document.getElementById('roulette-status').innerText = 'Placed ' + window.rSelectedChip + ' pts on ' + String(key).toUpperCase(); }; window.drawWheel = drawWheel; drawWheel();

const redNumbers = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36]; const winningIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * numbersOrder.length); const winningNumber = numbersOrder[winningIndex]; var spins = 5 + Math.random() * 3; const sliceAngle = (Math.PI * 2) / numbersOrder.length; const targetAngle = (Math.PI * 2) - (winningIndex * sliceAngle) - (sliceAngle / 2); var start = null; function animateSpin(timestamp) { if (!start) start = timestamp; const progress = (timestamp - start) / 3000; if (progress < 1) { const easeOut = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3); window.rAngle = easeOut * (spins * Math.PI * 2 + targetAngle); window.drawWheel(); requestAnimationFrame(animateSpin); } else { window.rAngle = targetAngle; window.drawWheel(); window.rSpinning = false; var winnings = 0; Object.keys(window.rBets).forEach(function(key) { var amount = window.rBets[key]; var parts = key.split(''); var type = parts[0]; var val = parts[1]; if (type === 'number' && parseInt(val) === winningNumber) winnings += amount * 36; else if (type === 'color' && val === 'red' && redNumbers.includes(winningNumber)) winnings += amount * 2; else if (type === 'color' && val === 'black' && !redNumbers.includes(winningNumber) && winningNumber !== 0) winnings += amount * 2; else if (type === 'evenodd' && val === 'even' && winningNumber !== 0 && winningNumber % 2 === 0) winnings += amount * 2; else if (type === 'evenodd' && val === 'odd' && winningNumber % 2 !== 0) winnings += amount * 2; }); state.points += winnings; updatePointsDisplay(); const isRed = redNumbers.includes(winningNumber); const colorName = winningNumber === 0 ? 'GREEN' : (isRed ? 'RED' : 'BLACK'); document.getElementById('roulette-status').innerText = 'Landed on ' + winningNumber + ' (' + colorName + ')! ' + (winnings > 0 ? 'You won ' + winnings + ' pts!' : 'No win this round.'); } } requestAnimationFrame(animateSpin);
